## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 -m pytest` passes
- [ ] The component's `version` is raised (new components start at `1.0.0`)
- [ ] The README has **What it does**, **Inputs**, **Outputs**, **AWS access**, **How it runs** and **Troubleshooting**
- [ ] `iam/policy.json` lists only the actions the code calls
- [ ] The component is safe to deliver twice
- [ ] I have said below whether it has run against a real AWS account
